Name: Buy Tea Set at Winter Star
Author: AirynS
Description:
A spin-off standalone feature from my larger Winter Star mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14272]Solstice Winter Star[/url], this small mod simply makes it possible to buy a tea set from Pierre’s stall at the Feast of the Winter Star. No more having to hope that your Winter Star secret gifter has correctly guessed your desire for hot drinks and inevitably be disappointed when you end up with clay or rocks - instead, just treat yourself and buy one! You deserve it.

To install, simply extract the “[CP] Buy Tea Set at Winter Star” folder and drop it in your Mods folder. Not tested on mobile, but it should work fine.
